name: Segilola
headline: Turn King’s usage data into players who stay.
saw: Your homepage sells Candy Crush Solitaire, Candy Crush Soda Saga and Farm Heroes Saga to every visitor the same way, and it pushes a promotion or discount to all of them alike.

Once a player is in a game, where they stall, which saga they return to and what they spend is the strongest signal you own for the next offer and the next lapse. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. The player who is about to lapse this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per player, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Lapse signals per player from missed sessions, stalled levels and spending drops. The right offer, channel and moment for each one, across in-game messages, push and email, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match the next saga to each player
cases.text: Next best saga, bundle or item per player, based on what they finish, where they stall and what they spend. No more one-size promotions sent to every player.

cases.head: Keep every player coming back this week
cases.text: Content and event nudges per player in game, push and email, so every player sees a reason to open King again. Timed to the sessions each player actually plays.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
